title: Hello World - Machine Learning Recipes #1
summary: The first episode of Google's Machine Learning Recipes series. It introduces machine learning and builds a first supervised-learning classifier in about six lines of Python using scikit-learn.
why: HN commenters recommend it as an approachable first step into machine learning for programmers, with an apples-vs-oranges classifier.

quote.text: Very approachable! The first lesson is a classifier to separate apples and oranges.
